target_customer: B2B sales and revenue teams running live calls
problem: Reps must answer technical questions and objections live without context, and call insight only arrives after the fact.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for real-time sales call copilot

founders.name: Omar Elamin
education: TU Delft (YC page says ex-TU Delft, degree not given)

competitors.name: Aircall AI Assist Pro
competitors.what: In-call coaching with objection handling prompts inside a calling platform

competitors.name: Revenue.io
competitors.what: Real-time guidance and objection responses for reps

competitors.name: Gong
competitors.what: Post-call conversation analytics, not live assistance

technical_complexity.rationale: Low-latency speech to answer pipeline over a company knowledge base plus Slack and CRM integrations is standard AI engineering with real latency challenges.

defensibility.rationale: The objection library compounds per customer, but live copilot features are shipping from Aircall, Revenue.io and others.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent platforms were adding live objection handling in 2025; no outcome yet for Caretta.

market_need_then: Sales teams adopt call recording and AI notes widely, and vendors were adding live objection support in 2025, showing demand for in-call help.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain product copy: Realtime AI for Sales Calls

brand_strength.rationale: Branding search surfaced only unrelated Caretta uses (a sea turtle species, an aquarium turtle, a Romanian metal firm); no brand coverage of the company.

outcome_analysis: Caretta is an active Winter 2026 company that raised a pre-seed in December 2025 and sells a real-time copilot for sales calls living in Slack. It is early with no public traction, and incumbents such as Aircall and Revenue.io were already adding live objection handling, so the outcome is undetermined.
notes: Funding conflicts: Nordic9 article (2025-12-18) says $800k pre-seed with the named investors; Signalbase says $1.3M pre-seed, PitchBook lists $1.51M seed on 2025-12-22 and $2.01M total, Neuronfeed says $500K. The $800k figure is recorded from the opened article; the others are unverified aggregator figures. Stage recorded as pre_seed per the article. Roles of the three founders come from the YC page.
